deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this busy market junction to allow safe crossing when traffic is stopped.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the centre of the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when traffic is stopped.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to allow wheelchair access and improve pedestrian safety.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during evening hours.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a formal footway, though some space exists between buildings and the road.
The right side is occupied by market stalls and lacks a dedicated footway.
While a crossing is needed, a signalised crossing is unrealistic for this narrow, informal market street.
The road is not wide enough to justify or accommodate a central refuge island.
There are no visible kerb ramps to facilitate accessibility.
The frames are taken during daylight, so the presence or absence of street lighting cannot be confirmed.
